name: Good Day Pista Badam Cookies
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALM OIL, SUGAR, NUTS (4%) (ALMONDS, CASHEWS, PISTACHIO), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, MILK SOLIDS, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii) & 500(ii)], BUTTER (0.5%), IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [322(i), 471, 472e], ARTIFICIAL (BUTTER, MILK, ALMOND & VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND COLOUR (102).
